beta_construction: For each seed, reuse the same fixed uniform master array of length 4800 used in batches A and B. For each N, reshape to (N, 4800/N) and take the arithmetic mean within each nested block.
coarsening_gate: Recompute every coarse beta as nested block means of the corresponding seed master; maximum absolute error must be exactly zero.
cross_size_metric: Two-dimensional principal-subspace overlap after common-grid embedding and reduced QR, preserving the complete 2x2 matrix and both assignment scores.
representation_fidelity: Compare linear-point and cell-average bases of the identical eigensubspace in both directions; do not normalize the cross-size score.
rank_control: Check native QR and both embedded same-N cross-pair overlaps; retain any linear-embedding leakage instead of changing the 1e-12 reference threshold.
strength_pairing: For every seed, compare the new r=0.2 realization with the existing r=0.1 realization from batch A or B using the identical master profile. These are paired descriptive controls, not independent disorder samples.
prior_result_policy: Read prior r=0.1 evidence from matched_beta_batch_a_analysis.json for seeds 0-3 and matched_beta_batch_b_analysis.json for seeds 4-7. Do not recompute or modify those results for this pairing.
outcome_policy: Retain every preregistered realization, grid, method and assignment. Do not select diagonal-dominant cases or remove swapped or mixed cases. Do not choose the next strength after inspecting outcomes.
old_candidate_role: The old seed=6 r=0.05 candidate is a different disorder realization; comparisons are descriptive and cannot be interpreted as a size-effect subtraction.
